functions.name: ConstructPropertyReplicationState
functions.docs: Construct the external state described by the descriptor in the given Buffer

functions.name: DestructPropertyReplicationState
functions.docs: Destruct the external state described by the descriptor in the given Buffer

functions.name: CopyPropertyReplicationState
functions.signature: CopyPropertyReplicationState(Dst State Buffer, Src State Buffer, Descriptor)
functions.docs: Copy external state in SrcStateBuffer to external state DstStateBuffer including changemask

functions.name: CopyDirtyMembers
functions.signature: CopyDirtyMembers(Dst State Buffer, Src State Buffer, Descriptor)
functions.docs: Copy only properties from external state in SrcStateBuffer to external state DstStateBufferif dirty, destination changemask will also be updated

functions.name: InternalApplyPropertyValue
functions.docs: Copy property value to target. If the property is fully replicated we use the properties copy function, otherwise we do a per member copy of all replicated data. Members with NetSerializers with an Apply() function will call that.

functions.name: InternalApplyStructProperty
functions.docs: Copy struct members to target using InternalApplyPropertyValue

functions.name: InternalCopyPropertyValue
functions.docs: Copy property value, if the property is fully replicated we use the properties copy function, otherwise we do a per member copy of all replicated data

functions.name: InternalCompareStructProperty
functions.signature: InternalCompareStructProperty(Struct Descriptor, Value A, Value B)
functions.docs: Compare struct members using InternalCompareMember, this function will only compare replicated members of the struct

functions.name: InternalCompareMember
functions.signature: InternalCompareMember(Descriptor, Member Index, Value A, Value B)
functions.docs: CompareMembers, if data is not fully replicated we will use per member compare for structs and arrays

functions.name: InternalCompareAndCopyArrayWithElementChangeMask
functions.signature: InternalCompareAndCopyArrayWithElementChangeMask(Descriptor, Member Index, Dst Array, Src Array, Change Mask)
